title: Conway 99图问题的强制结构约简与可验证界
summary: 本文报告了由自主AI研究代理对Conway 99图问题（srg(99,14,1,2)存在性）的系统攻击。贡献包括：循环图约束满足上限68.0%的穷举证明、强制结构约简（将问题化为84顶点12正则图）、验证的自同构轨道存在性框架，以及最佳验证结果69.43%，并表明这是鲁棒前沿。
summary_en: This paper reports a systematic attack by an autonomous AI research agent on Conway's 99-graph problem (existence of srg(99,14,1,2)). Contributions include an exhaustive proof that no circulant graph satisfies more than 68.0% of constraints, a forced-structure reduction to a 12-regular graph on 84 vertices, a validated prescribed-automorphism orbit-existence framework, and a best verified artifact at 69.43%, with evidence of a robust frontier.
